snohomishcountywa.gov.es: la oficina electoral del condado de Snohomish (Snohomish County Elections)

reg_deadline.en: Online or by mail: must be received by Monday, October 26. In person: at any county elections office until 8 p.m. on Election Day.
reg_deadline.es: En línea o por correo: debe recibirse a más tardar el lunes 26 de octubre. En persona: en cualquier oficina electoral de condado hasta las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones.
reg_deadline.quote: Online and mail registrations must be received 8 days before Election Day.
reg_deadline.en_after: Online and by mail closed October 26. In person: at any county elections office until 8 p.m. on Election Day.
reg_deadline.es_after: En línea y por correo cerró el 26 de octubre. En persona: en cualquier oficina electoral de condado hasta las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones.

mail_request.notes: Every registered voter is mailed a ballot; there is no request deadline.

mail_return.en: Drop box: by 8 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3. Mail: postmarked on or before November 3, and no stamp needed. Postmarks aren't guaranteed on the day you mail, so mail it a week early, by Tuesday, October 27, or use a drop box after that.
mail_return.es: Buzón: a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre. Correo: con matasellos del 3 de noviembre o antes, y no necesita estampilla. El matasellos no está garantizado el mismo día que la envías, así que mándala una semana antes, a más tardar el martes 27 de octubre, o después de esa fecha usa un buzón.
mail_return.quote: if the ballot was postmarked on or before Election Day.
mail_return.en_after: Drop box: by 8 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3. Mail: postmarked on or before November 3, and no stamp needed. Postmarks aren't guaranteed on the day you mail, so use a drop box now.
mail_return.es_after: Buzón: a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre. Correo: con matasellos del 3 de noviembre o antes, y no necesita estampilla. El matasellos no está garantizado el mismo día que la envías, así que ahora mejor usa un buzón.

cure.en: Signature problem on your envelope? Your county has to tell you within three business days of getting your ballot. Fix it by the close of business on Monday, November 23, the day before your county certifies the results.
cure.es: ¿Hay un problema con la firma de tu sobre? Tu condado tiene que avisarte dentro de los tres días hábiles después de recibir tu boleta. Corrígelo antes del cierre de oficinas del lunes 23 de noviembre, el día antes de que tu condado certifique los resultados.
cure.quote: The voter identified on the ballot return envelope must be notified as soon as practicable, but no later than three business days following receipt, that the signature on the ballot declaration does not match the signature(s) in the voter registration record. ... (2) The voter may cure their ballot signature no later than the close of business the day before the election is certified.
cure.notes: WAC 434-261-053, adopted WSR 25-22-012, effective Nov 24, 2025. Certification date: RCW 29A.60.190, https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/default.aspx?cite=29A.60.190 (Oct 28): counties certify 'twenty-one days after a general election', so Tuesday, Nov 24, 2026; the day before is Monday, Nov 23. Replaces the 'missing' entry (the SOS FAQ gives no date).

in_person.en: There's no polling place to find. Your ballot comes to you. Need help in person? Every county has a voting center, open during business hours through 8 p.m. on Election Day, where you can register, get a replacement ballot or use an accessible voting machine.
in_person.es: No tienes que buscar un lugar de votación. Tu boleta te llega a ti. ¿Necesitas ayuda en persona? Cada condado tiene un centro de votación, abierto en horario de oficina hasta las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones, donde puedes registrarte, pedir una boleta de reemplazo o usar una máquina de votación accesible.
in_person.quote: available until 8 p.m. on Election Day.
in_person.notes: Business hours through 8 p.m.: RCW 29A.40.160(1), https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/default.aspx?cite=29A.40.160 (Oct 28): 'The voting center shall be open during business hours during the voting period, which begins eighteen days before, and ends at 8:00 p.m. on the day of, the ... general election.'

locator_label.en: VoteWA.gov drop boxes and voting centers
locator_label.es: Buzones y centros de votación en VoteWA.gov

accepted.notes: No ID is needed to return a mail ballot; the signature on the envelope is the check. The existing FAQ answer covers it.

who.en: Ballots went out by October 16. Didn't get one? Print a replacement at VoteWA.gov or call your county elections office. If you end up with two ballots, send back just one. Only one counts.
who.es: Las boletas se enviaron a más tardar el 16 de octubre. ¿No te llegó la tuya? Imprime una de reemplazo en VoteWA.gov o llama a la oficina electoral de tu condado. Si terminas con dos boletas, devuelve solo una. Solo una cuenta.
who.quote: If you are a registered voter and do not receive your ballot, contact your county elections office.

witness.en: Sign the envelope. Your county compares it with the signature on file. Can't sign? Make a mark in front of two witnesses and have them sign in the spaces on the envelope.
witness.es: Firma el sobre. Tu condado compara la firma con la que tiene en tu registro. ¿No puedes firmar? Haz una marca frente a dos testigos y pídeles que firmen en los espacios del sobre.
witness.quote: make a mark in front of two witnesses and have them sign in the designated spaces.

cure.en: Forgot to sign, or your signature looks different now? Your county will contact you by mail, and by phone, text or email if it has them, with a form to fix it. Send the form back by the close of business on Monday, November 23. Check your ballot status on VoteWA.gov.
cure.es: ¿Se te olvidó firmar o tu firma se ve diferente ahora? Tu condado te contactará por correo, y por teléfono, mensaje de texto o correo electrónico si los tiene, con un formulario para corregirlo. Devuelve el formulario antes del cierre de oficinas del lunes 23 de noviembre. Revisa el estado de tu boleta en VoteWA.gov.
cure.quote: The county must notify the voter of the procedure for curing their signature by: (a) A notice letter package sent by first class mail with a signature update form or a missing signature form. ... (b) Telephone ... (c) Text message (if the voter has opted into text message notifications); and (d) Email ... (2) The voter may cure their ballot signature no later than the close of business the day before the election is certified.
cure.notes: Was 'Watch your mail and email for a week or so after you send it' (Oct 21, SOS FAQ). Nov 23 = day before the Nov 24 certification (RCW 29A.60.190, 21 days after the general election). Text messages go to voters who opted in.

dropbox.en: Drop boxes close at 8 p.m. on Election Day. Mailing it late? Take it to a post office counter and ask them to hand-stamp the postmark.
dropbox.es: Los buzones cierran a las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones. ¿La mandas tarde por correo? Llévala al mostrador de una oficina postal y pide que le pongan el matasellos a mano.
dropbox.quote: bring it into your local post office and ask a USPS employee to hand-stamp the postmark on it.

gear.en: No campaigning near voting. Within 100 feet of a voting center entrance, or 25 feet of a ballot drop box, no one may urge votes for or against a candidate or measure, hand out cards or fliers, or gather petition signatures.
gear.es: Nada de campaña cerca de donde se vota. A menos de 100 pies de la entrada de un centro de votación, o a menos de 25 pies de un buzón de entrega de boletas, nadie puede pedir el voto a favor o en contra de un candidato o una medida, repartir tarjetas o volantes, ni juntar firmas para peticiones.
gear.quote: Within a voting center or student engagement hub or in any public street or room in any public manner within 100 feet measured radially from the entrance to a voting center or student engagement hub or 25 feet measured radially from a ballot drop box as described in RCW 29A.40.170 : (i) Suggest or persuade or attempt to suggest or persuade any voter to vote for or against any candidate or ballot measure; (ii) Circulate cards or handbills of any kind; (iii) Solicit signatures to any kind of petition;
gear.notes: RCW 29A.84.510(1)(a), read Oct 28. Applies during the 18-day voting period.

line.en: In line at a voting center or ballot drop box at 8 p.m.? Stay in line. You can still vote and drop off your ballot.
line.es: ¿Estás en la fila de un centro de votación o de un buzón a las 8 p. m.? No te salgas. Todavía puedes votar y dejar tu boleta.
line.quote: Any voter who is in line at 8:00 p.m. may vote and deposit their ballot.

tradition.en: Snohomish County has seven new I Voted designs for the November 3 election, showing the county's landscapes, industries and cultures. One was made with the Tulalip Tribes and reflects Coast Salish heritage. Once you've returned your ballot, you can get one at the Auditor's Office in Everett, any Sno-Isle Libraries location or an accessible voter services site, during their open hours.
tradition.es: El condado de Snohomish tiene siete diseños nuevos de sticker de "I Voted" para las elecciones del 3 de noviembre, con paisajes, industrias y culturas del condado. Uno se hizo junto con las Tribus Tulalip (Tulalip Tribes) y refleja la herencia cultural Coast Salish. Cuando ya hayas entregado tu boleta, puedes conseguir uno en la oficina del auditor en Everett (Auditor's Office), en cualquier biblioteca de Sno-Isle Libraries o en un centro accesible de servicios para votantes, en su horario de atención.
tradition.en_after: For the November 3, 2026 election, Snohomish County offered seven new I Voted designs, showing the county's landscapes, industries and cultures, at the Auditor's Office in Everett, Sno-Isle Libraries and accessible voter services sites. One was made with the Tulalip Tribes and reflects Coast Salish heritage.
tradition.es_after: Para las elecciones del 3 de noviembre de 2026, el condado de Snohomish ofreció siete diseños nuevos de sticker de "I Voted", con paisajes, industrias y culturas del condado, en la oficina del auditor en Everett (Auditor's Office), las bibliotecas de Sno-Isle Libraries y los centros accesibles de servicios para votantes. Uno se hizo junto con las Tribus Tulalip (Tulalip Tribes) y refleja la herencia cultural Coast Salish.
tradition.quote: one of Snohomish County’s new “I Voted” stickers, available at the Auditor’s Office in Everett, all Sno-Isle Libraries locations
tradition.notes: Release posted Oct 7, 2026 ("Ballots for November 3 Election Will Be Mailed to Voters on October 9"). Next sentence: "Voters can choose from seven designs that highlight some of the landscapes, industries, and cultures that make Snohomish County unique, including a new design created in collaboration with the Tulalip Tribes that reflects Coast Salish cultural heritage." No drop boxes named.

mail.en: Check your ballot packet first, since some counties put a sticker in it. Thurston County includes its "I Voted" sticker, by local artist Alexis Trono, in every ballot packet through the 2027 primary, this election included.
mail.es: Primero revisa el paquete de tu boleta, porque algunos condados incluyen un sticker. El condado de Thurston pone su sticker de "I Voted", obra de la artista local Alexis Trono, en todos los paquetes de boletas hasta las primarias de 2027, incluida esta elección.
mail.quote: be included in every ballot packet through the 2027 Primary Election, including the 2026 federal midterms

line.en: You can still vote. Anyone in line at a voting center or ballot drop box at 8 p.m. can vote and drop off their ballot.
line.es: Igual puedes votar. Toda persona que esté en la fila de un centro de votación o de un buzón a las 8 p. m. puede votar y dejar su boleta.
line.quote: Any voter who is in line at 8:00 p.m. may vote and deposit their ballot.

track.en: Sign in to VoteWA.gov and check your ballot status, or text VOTE to 868392 for updates by text message.
track.es: Entra a VoteWA.gov y revisa el estado de tu boleta, o manda VOTE por mensaje de texto al 868392 para recibir avisos.
track.quote: Sign in to VoteWA.gov to check your ballot status.

unsigned.en: Your county will contact you with a form to sign or fix it before your ballot is counted. Send it back by the close of business on Monday, November 23.
unsigned.es: Tu condado te contactará con un formulario para firmar o corregir tu sobre antes de contar tu boleta. Devuélvelo antes del cierre de oficinas del lunes 23 de noviembre.
unsigned.quote: If a ballot declaration signature is not accepted following secondary review, the voter used a mark or signature stamp but did not include witnesses, or if the ballot declaration was not signed, the ballot cannot be counted until the voter cures their signature. ... The voter may cure their ballot signature no later than the close of business the day before the election is certified.

late_mail.en: A mailed ballot counts if it's postmarked on or before November 3, but postmarks aren't guaranteed on the day you mail it. In the last week, use a drop box or ask the post office counter to hand-stamp it.
late_mail.es: Una boleta por correo cuenta si tiene matasellos del 3 de noviembre o antes, pero el matasellos no está garantizado el mismo día que la envías. En la última semana, usa un buzón o pide en el mostrador de la oficina postal que le pongan el matasellos a mano.
late_mail.quote: if the ballot was postmarked on or before Election Day.

notes: Read October 21, 2026 on sos.wa.gov: FAQ on voting by mail, dates and deadlines, the June 29 postmark ruling news item, the February drop box news item (hand-stamp advice, USPS one-week guidance). October 27 is a week before Election Day, per the USPS advice, not a separate official date. Electioneering distance, voting center hours and the signature cure deadline were not found; left missing.
